package rulefixtures

import (
	"net/http"
	"runtime"
)

// scenario for runtime_gomaxprocs_per_request: `runtime.GOMAXPROCS(...)` on request paths.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
func scenario633Positive(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	prev := runtime.GOMAXPROCS(0)
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(prev * 2)
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
}
